scheme_name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Consolidation of Coffee
other_conditions: Applicant’s area must not have received consolidation subsidy during the XII Plan period
Applicant’s land records must be in their name
Applicant must procure seed material for gap filling or consolidation exclusively from the Coffee Board
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of 50% of the unit cost (₹30,000 per hectare) paid in two installments.
documents_required: Land records or certified possession certificate
